findings.what_happens: Records {date, storeId, ok:false, error:message} in results array; NO console log; swallows the throw before Inngest's retry/deadletter machinery can see it; loop marches forward through all remaining pairs (default 63 for 21d×3 stores).
findings.reasoning: Cross-validates INN-16. Pattern is acceptable for one-off per-pair failures but pathological for systemic failures (schema-level RLS denial, missing migration, broken env var): the loop burns the entire exec budget on identical failures without escalation.
findings.fix_sketch: (a) Add console.warn inside the catch so per-pair failure is visible in Inngest run logs. (b) Add 'systemic-failure abort' guard: if first 3 consecutive pairs fail with same error message, throw to let Inngest retry the whole event.

operator_directives_applied: Sweep covered BOTH grep shapes (catch ( + catch {) per D-12 spirit, not just the regex literal.
